traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Love and value meet imagination. Heightened artistic sensibility and romantic idealism. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Seeing what you want to see in love, idealizing people, and the disillusionment that follows. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

readerCopy.summary: Fast chemistry and easy enthusiasm get mistaken for a firm commitment.
readerCopy.body: Fast chemistry and easy enthusiasm get mistaken for a firm commitment. A trip, joint venture, or social plan gathers momentum before anyone checks the cost or writes down the terms. Venus keeps the interest alive, while Neptune lets the grand vision outrun the facts. The opposition places the irresistible version of the offer across from the price and conditions nobody confirmed. The ideal outcome may remain attractive even as confusion grows over what was agreed and who is expected to pay.
